specialists.name: Dr. Lauren Michon
specialists.desc: Lauren is passionate about helping patients improve their quality of life and continue pursuing joyful activities. Lauren is certified in advanced Integrative Dry Needling (CIDN), hawkgrips (IASTM), kinesiotaping, and cupping.
specialists.alt: Dr. Lauren Michon - PT, DPT, CIDN, RPT

specialists.name: Dr. Becca Wilner
specialists.desc: Dr. Becca earned her Doctor of Physical Therapy from the University of Michigan-Flint in 2018 and specializes in outpatient orthopedics. Certified in dry needling, she has a special interest in dancers and gymnasts, helping patients recover safely.

specialists.name: Mike Rosenburg
specialists.desc: As an NCAA athlete who faced injury challenges, Mike understands the frustration of chronic pain. Over 8 years, he's tailored his approach ensuring patients lead a pain-free life without surgeries or medications.

specialists.name: Ben Blankenship
specialists.desc: Ben, founder of RPT Clinic, once grappled with severe lower back pain. From athlete with lumbar pain to discovering RPT's life-changing results, he's committed to providing others his breakthrough non-invasive therapy.

specialists.name: Dr. Stephanie
specialists.desc: Stephanie earned her diploma from the National Personal Training Institute of Michigan in March 2011. Her lifelong involvement in dance and various sports laid the foundation for her dedication to self-care and personal growth.
specialists.alt: Dr. Jack Cygan - BS, DC, RPT
